purpose: Teach: 焼きそば/シチュー/ヘルシー/試飲/薄め/ふき/アサヒ/お中元

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お祭りで、絶対、焼きそば、絶対、食べたわ
lines.en: Sho, I really did eat yakisoba at the festival, you know.
lines.style: Warm, animated energy. Speaks with gentle certainty and affection. Leans toward him slightly. Bright, unhurried pace with small uplifts on the remembered details.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ママの、絶対、シチュー、絶対、大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love Mom's stew so much.
lines.style: Eager, genuine child's voice. Eyes light up at the memory. Quick, open delivery on 「好き」. Small but earnest — no performance, just real enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ヘルシー、絶対、なご飯、絶対、心がけてるわ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, I try to make sure we eat healthily, Sho.
lines.style: Thoughtful, sincere tone. Steady pace. Slight warmth underneath — speaking to him like he's old enough to understand. Trailing softly on the explanation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ジュース、絶対、試飲、絶対、お店で、絶対、したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I actually got to taste-test juice at the store!
lines.style: Bright, animated child's voice. Quick energy. The excitement of a small adventure. Rushes slightly on 「試飲」 like he's still amazed it happened.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、コーヒー、絶対、薄め、絶対、が、絶対、お好きよ、翔くん
lines.en: I've been drinking my coffee a bit lighter lately, Sho.
lines.style: Gentle, observational tone. Quiet certainty. Speaks as though sharing something she's noticed about herself. Soft, reflective — not seeking approval, just conversing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お祖母ちゃんの、絶対、ふき、絶対、料理、絶対、食べたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got to eat Grandma's butterbur dish!
lines.style: Animated, proud child's voice. Immediate, genuine excitement. Rises slightly on 「食べた」. Small and unselfconscious — purely happy about the memory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、アサヒ、絶対、新聞、絶対、毎日、絶対、読んでるわ、翔くん
lines.en: I read the Asahi newspaper every day, you know.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact delivery. Gentle without being condescending. Speaks like sharing a small habit she's proud of. Steady pace, slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんから、本気で、絶対、お中元、絶対、お祖母ちゃんに、絶対、送ってあげたいよ
lines.en: I really want to send Grandma a summer gift from me, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Tender, earnest child's voice. Quiet determination underneath the sweetness. Speaks with gentle care about his intention. Slight trailing-off at the end — checking if she thinks it's a good idea.
